title: acer palmatum f. palmatipartitum
intro: Acer palmatum f. palmatipartitum, commonly known as Japanese Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree with distinctive, deeply lobed leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Maple include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of Japanese Maple, including quercetin and kaempferol, have been shown to have anti-cancer and antimicrobial properties.
